items.title: Jessie Charles Interview, 1967-12-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Names of Constance. Wait, let's back up. That was the biology. Okay. What about the Zulu Parades?

ctx.x: She was asking you about the zoos. Have you ever seen it?
Names of Constance. Wait, let's back up. That was the biology. Okay. What about the Zulu Parades?

The Zulu Parades. Well, they have their big parades on the count of them. They have Zulu Parades during the summertime, too. They have one or two parades. But they have big days on the count of them. Just like last day on the count of them, that's when they have their big days. They have floats like Rex and them. They don't have as many of them, but they have a few of them.
